label: CODEX CONTINUATION
status: Fixed before any historical row-outcome audit; synthetic-only implementation until parent review/refutation.
purpose: Posthoc descriptive existing held-out-development error contrasts by six fixed feature flags; not causal intervention, fresh validation or model selection.

flag_definitions.hourly_range_outside_clip10: Any original float32 normalized hourly range before clipping strictly below -10 or above +10; exact boundaries excluded.
flag_definitions.daily_range_outside_clip10: Any original float32 normalized daily-block range before clipping strictly below -10 or above +10; exact boundaries excluded.
flag_definitions.HAR_scale_fallback: Original HAR hourly scale fallback: exp(float32 lsH)/sqrt(8760) nonfinite or nonpositive; original fallback is 0.02.
flag_definitions.static_lvol_nonfinite: Original static lvol after original float32 cast is nonfinite before nan_to_num and clipping.
flag_definitions.hourly_return_window_nonfinite: Any nonfinite original raw hourly return in the clipped-index hourly window, before nan_to_num.
flag_definitions.volume_loader_returned_none: Unchanged original D.load_volume returned None; includes non-grid, missing column or swallowed parse/read exception, not true volume-source absence.

metric_definitions: Stored probabilities without clipping/rounding. Brier_difference=model minus fH; BSS=1-model_Brier/fH_Brier only when fH_Brier>0, otherwise null. Calibration=predicted_mean/observed_rate, null zero positives. Zero-support slices retained with n=0, positives=0 and null metrics. All360 original accepted census flag totals must match before metrics are calculated.
access_protocol: Distinct new protocol authorizes existing binary daily outcomes/fH/allfive predictions. Authenticate old evidence and frozen helpers; admit only exact authenticated prediction archives during RAM preload; then unchanged accepted Q.guard denies prediction file loads except exact streamed hash-only integrity rechecks. Original merged input NPZ archives remain admitted for feature reconstruction and contain Y/fH, so this is not column-level outcome isolation. Actual metrics code uses admitted preloaded Y/fH/prediction columns. No prior guard weakening, new data/labels/fits or per-row archives.
execution: Parent reads actual source, independently runs synthetic tests and obtains separate refutation before historical execution. Parent external RSS/wall monitor required; helper checks resource boundaries. Aggregate compact JSON only <=5MB.
limitations: Flags overlap and all models/flags reuse observations; contrast does not establish harm or causation. Retrospective seen-development support with future-peer training in early-time cells, not fresh forward/blind evidence. No p-values, new gates, rankings, tuning, clipping changes or model-selection/promotion claims.

preserved_unexecuted_v1.status: Unexecuted review draft; access-boundary wording corrected without changing feature flags or metric arithmetic. No historical run occurred.
